authorization.scope: User authorized launch: first-step lambda 0.5 and third-step lambda 0.1/0.3/0.5, unchanged 48 prompts and seed, generation plus objective scoring and analysis; at most four currently idle GPUs

selection: Reuse all H2 motion/objects prompts and metric mappings; exclude scene library
renoise_policy: Reuse exactly the original first-step per-prompt random stream for all strengths and intervention positions
gpu_selection: Discover all physical GPUs at each dispatch; no resident process, <=32 MiB used, zero utilization, >=100 GiB free; recheck at worker admission
conflict_policy: Keep completed arms; relinquish own worker; cool down the contested GPU for 10 minutes, 30 minutes after recurrence; prefer idle GPUs with fewer conflicts
residency: single DiT on GPU; count teacher/student transfers in inference time
variant_order: Rotate the four new arms by frozen prompt index; same initial and re-noise samples across positions and strengths
analysis: Full panel plus fixed H2 T>S/T<S/T=S quality subgroups; matched-lambda third-minus-first contrasts; dynamic_degree is a motion guard, with no automatic acceptance threshold
stopping_point: Finish only the four new arms and their three existing metrics; merge prior results and stop
